name: Concord
description: A star clipped back to a ring, so only the points that reach it survive.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 60.0% 32.7%, 93.3% 25.0%, 70.0% 50.0%, 93.3% 75.0%, 60.0% 67.3%, 50.0% 100.0%, 40.0% 67.3%, 6.7% 75.0%, 30.0% 50.0%, 6.7% 25.0%, 40.0% 32.7%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 60.0% 32.7%, 93.3% 25.0%, 70.0% 50.0%, 93.3% 75.0%, 60.0% 67.3%, 50.0% 100.0%, 40.0% 67.3%, 6.7% 75.0%, 30.0% 50.0%, 6.7% 25.0%, 40.0% 32.7%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 24%, #000 24% 50%, transparent 50%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 24%, #000 24% 50%, transparent 50%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
